name: orchestrate
description: Manage edge devices and roll out applications with logiccloud orchestrate (formerly Fleet Manager): the orchestrate MCP server (API key) and skills for the lco CLI.

domain.title: orchestrate domain
domain.description: Root domain of your orchestrate installation, without https:// (e.g. orchestrate.example.com). The MCP server is https://mcp.<domain>/mcp.

api_key.title: orchestrate API key
api_key.description: An API key from orchestrate (Settings > Security > API Keys). Its scopes decide what the agent may do.
